command.value:
set -e
umask 077
tls_dir=$(mktemp -d)
printf %s "$RAYMEDIOS_CA_CRT_BASE64" | base64 -d > "$tls_dir/ca.crt"
printf %s "$RAYMEDIOS_CLIENT_CRT_BASE64" | base64 -d > "$tls_dir/client.crt"
printf %s "$RAYMEDIOS_CLIENT_KEY_BASE64" | base64 -d > "$tls_dir/client.key"
export RAY_KUBERAY_CA_CERT_PATH="$tls_dir/ca.crt" RAY_KUBERAY_CLIENT_CERT_PATH="$tls_dir/client.crt" RAY_KUBERAY_CLIENT_KEY_PATH="$tls_dir/client.key"
( until ray health-check --address node-a:31000 > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 5; done; exec ray kuberay-autoscaler --cluster-name c1 --cluster-namespace ns --gcs-address node-a:31000 ) &
exec ray start --block --node-ip-address=node-a --node-manager-port=31005 --object-manager-port=31006 --runtime-env-agent-port=31007 --metrics-export-port=31008 --dashboard-agent-listen-port=31009 --dashboard-agent-grpc-port=31010 --worker-port-list=31011,31012,31013,31014 --num-cpus=1 --num-gpus=0 --memory=2147483648 --object-store-memory=643825664 --head --port=31000 --ray-client-server-port=31001 --include-dashboard=true --dashboard-host=0.0.0.0 --dashboard-port=31003 --no-monitor
